name: Commonborn
summary: The body everyone is born into before the world has an opinion about them. It stops where mortals stop and lends no discipline, which is exactly why it is weak: nothing about its anatomy favours a path, so a Commonborn must settle on one early and is weakest precisely where a specialist is strongest. Mind is closed to it outright — a body this even has no native faculty for it. (full text in lore/prose/races/commonborn.md)

name: Emberblood
summary: A body that runs hot and short. It refines qi faster than anything here and reads intent at the speed of a struck match, at the cost of a lifespan measured in decades rather than centuries and a mind path that closes once the furnace is lit. Fire affinity is structural, not a gift.

name: Emberborn
summary: A line from the founding generation of a body that burned through its own reserve and kept going. Recorded alongside the stone line because the two were crossed at the same conception and have stayed crossed since, which is why the concentration is thin and unevenly spread. The grant is defensive and fires continuously: a slower burn rather than a bigger tank.

name: Hearthborn
summary: The default concentration found in long-settled households: a lineage carried carefully for many generations, averaged with whatever else the household took in. Common as a stat-block and unsurprising as a reading — most actors hold some, and most never cross its bar. Its grant is small on purpose; the line is common because it is dependable, not because it is strong.

name: Stoneborn
summary: A dense, slow body assembled for load-bearing work. It carries more physique and stamina than anything else here and it stops at the Immortal tier, because the density that makes it durable is the same density that will not let a dantian form. Mind cultivation is closed outright.

name: Tideborn
summary: The oldest recorded carrier line, kept in one household so long that the name stopped describing a family and started describing a body. Two generations of pure pairing is the most this line has ever held, and the bar is set where it is because that is exactly the ceiling of an unbroken chain. Its grant trades immediate impact for sustained pressure: nothing here lands harder, everything here lasts.

name: Tidecaller
summary: A long-lived body built for perception rather than force. Comprehension and will carry it through realms that would end a hotter body, and it cannot take the body path at all: it was assembled for looking, not for being hit. Water affinity is the only one it holds.

name: Tideculled
summary: A line maintained by a clan that culled its own branches rather than marrying out of them. The concentration survives because the gene pool was narrowed, not improved, and it crosses races freely — the cull was a political act, never an anatomical one. Its grant favours sustained effort over sudden effort: regen and cultivation pace, nothing that spikes.

name: Voidborn
summary: A line with no recorded origin and no household that will admit to it. The founding bar is set at 0.72 because the arithmetic leaves exactly one generation of pure-by-pure inheritance able to clear it: anything weaker is unobtainable by any pairing and the content would be dead. This lineage is the system's proof that its own ladder is reachable.
